question: Adopt S4 (palindromic composition of zig-zag blocks with integer steps m = (1,1,1,1,-2,1,1,1,1)) instead of the frozen zig-zag? What does its lattice light cone (1.667 c) do: precursors, signals, paradoxes?
engine: lab/locale_core.py (3-D/2-D walks), lab/locale_s4_core.py (1-D Dirac in k-space with minimal coupling, radial hydrogen RadialS4 = the RadialWalk shift and local rotation composed with the sequence; SEQ_FROZEN = (1,) reproduces the frozen spectrum).

exams.P1_cells: N_1% (worst of phase, group, diffraction) of S4 <= 0.6 x frozen, 2-D and 3-D. (Already measured in phase 1: 14.4/36.3 and 14.6/36.3; restated, not re-run.)
exams.P2_mass: 3-D Dirac S4 at theta = 0.1: |E(0)/m - 1| <= 1e-12 and |m_kin/m - 1| <= 1e-4 (phase 1: 1.8e-5; restated).
exams.P3_hydrogen: radial form, Z = 1, infinite nucleus, rmax = 30 a0, theta in {0.2, 0.1, 0.05}: relative binding error vs the Sommerfeld-Dirac formula for 1s, 2s, 2p1/2, 2p3/2. PASS if at theta = 0.1 S4 is >= 10x better than frozen for all four, AND the S4 error ratio theta 0.1 -> 0.05 is >= 8 for all four, AND the fine structure 2p3/2 - 2p1/2 of S4 has relative error <= 1e-4 at theta = 0.1. Eigen residual <= 1e-8.
exams.P4_schwinger: 1-D Dirac, theta = 0.1, constant field E/E_c in {0.5, 1, 2, 4} (E_c = m^2 in lattice units): one mode starting in the negative band at k_eff = -0.4, swept to +0.4; probability in the positive band vs exp(-pi m^2/E). PASS if |P/P_Schwinger - 1| <= 5% for E/E_c in {1, 2, 4} for S4 (frozen reported alongside). Information: the same sweep to +-0.8, crossing the first Floquet fold of S4.
exams.P5_folding: S4 period is 6x (1-D) / 6x (3-D) longer than the frozen one, so quasi-energies fold 6x sooner. (a) light 2-D/3-D: no avoided crossing of a moving band with gap > 1e-6 (eigenvalue splitting) for N >= 13 cells/lambda; (b) 1-D Dirac: report the gap at the first fold (k where E T = pi) and the window |E| < pi/T in units of m.
exams.P6_causality: 2-D light, box 384^2, source at the centre, F = (0, 0, f) (transverse), run to t = 120 (lattice units, c = 1), frozen and S4. Smooth compact source f = (1 - r^2/R^2)^4 for r < R, R in {3, 6, 12, 24}; sharp disk R = 12. Measure the energy fraction at r > t + R + 1 (outside the TRUE light cone) at t = 30, 60, 90, 120, and the arrival time at a receiver at distance 100 (axis and diagonal) for thresholds eps = 1e-3, 1e-6, 1e-9, 1e-12 of the peak energy density there -> v(eps) = (100 - R)/t. PASS (causality acceptable) if for smooth R >= 6 the outside fraction at t = 120 is <= 1e-6 and v(1e-6) <= 1.01 c, AND for the sharp disk the outside fraction of S4 is <= 10x the frozen one.
exams.P7_variants: the cone of an integer 4th-order composition with |m| <= c is >= (c^2+1)/(c^2-1) (analytic, checked on all solutions of the phase-1 search); variant seq_c(4) (32 ones, -4, 32 ones; cone 1.133): N_1% (2-D) and Floquet folding reported (information).

verdict_rule: ADOPT if P1, P2, P3, P4, P6 pass. ADOPT WITH A WINDOW if only P6 fails for sharp/unresolved sources and P5(a) passes. DO NOT ADOPT if P3 or P4 fail.

dev_seen_before_prereg.folding_light: S4 2-D: crossings of the two moving bands at kT = pi exact (gap ~1e-8); moving vs static at kT = 2pi (k ~ 0.52, N ~ 12) avoided, gap 0.02-0.19 depending on direction
dev_seen_before_prereg.c4: 1-D: T = 60, pi-gap 0.029 at k = 0.12, near-zero folded gap 1e-3
